title: Nissan USA newsroom: 2024 LEAF press kit
notes: 2024 LEAF US press kit: S 40 kWh, SV PLUS "60 kWh" (marketing figure for the 62 kWh pack); 6.6 kW onboard charger (6.0 out); high-output quick charge port standard on both trims; 80 % in about 40 min (S) / 60 min (SV PLUS), start state of charge not stated; no battery preconditioning described.
